name: bug-hunt
description: Standalone home of the bug-hunt Claude Code plugin, extracted from locriani/ai-additions.

plugins.name: bug-hunt
plugins.description: Headless, repo-agnostic bug hunt: finders read the hottest files from five angles, provers write a repro that must fail against the current code, and a verifier must turn it green with a fix before a bug is reported. Report only; `bug-hunt run` wraps claude -p in a throwaway worktree with a spend cap and exits 1 on proven bugs.
